evidence: From the carpark the route initially follows an old farm track.
The track begins at a car park about 500 m along the Dorothy Falls Road from the last road bridge across the Styx River and initially follows a rough 4WD route.

Once reached, cross this bridge to the true right bank of the Arahura River and follow the old logging road and river flats through private farmland before reaching the public road near the Milltown Bridge.

doubts: The page is titled as valley tracks but describes one sequential trip from the Styx road end over Styx Saddle down the Arahura to the public road near Milltown Bridge, so it is recorded as one_way. The text does not say whether the trip can be walked in reverse. The start ref F2 (unnamed track meets Dorothy Falls Road) is chosen over F3 (Lake Kaniere Walkway); the text says the car park is about 500 m along Dorothy Falls Road from the last Styx bridge, which I could not check against the map points. The Styx River is crossed three times on the marked route, each recorded as a ford. The extended day to Harman Hut, Lake Browning/Whakarewa and Browning Pass/Noti Raureka is recorded as side trips from Styx Saddle. DOC's '11 km one way' looks short for the described trip but is copied as given.
